newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Lux's Juncker sees Germany making EMU criteria.
newsitem.headline: Lux's Juncker sees Germany making EMU criteria.

text.p: Luxembourg Prime Minister and Finance Minister Jean-Claude Juncker said on Monday he believed Germany would meet the criteria for economic and monetary union (EMU) but that it was up to Bonn to decide whether further budgetary measures were needed.
Juncker was speaking as he arrived for a European Union finance ministers meeting that was to discuss the economic convergence plans of Germany and France.
"I think the Germans will make it...and the French," Juncker said.
Asked about Germany's convergence plan, Juncker said: "It's a convincing document but it shows all the difficulties Germany and other may have."
He said it was "up to the Germans" to decide whether they "need stronger (budgetary) action."
